'''Oby Bobissia'''<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1487690195877064705|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2022-01-30|quote=These are two Podracer models re-dressed and repurposed as new characters. Ark "Bumpy" Roose is now Slyther Bushforb, and Ebe Endicott is Oby Bobissia. A CG Mars Guo re-dress was planned but never made it to screen.|archivedate=20220205184303}}</ref> was a [[Triffian]] with light skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|II}}</ref> they spoke animatedly with the [[Nuknog]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Slyther Bushforb]]<ref name="Twitter" /> outside<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Dex's Diner]] in the [[CoCo Town]] district of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> shortly before Bushforb then entered the diner. Bobissia wore a green [[Clothing|jumpsuit]] and black [[boot]]s.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oby Bobissia appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The character was a re-dressed and repurposed version of the animated model for the [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Ebe E. Endocott]],<ref name="Twitter" /> a character created for the [[1999]] prequel film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> Concept art of the characer's costume for use for the computer animation done by [[Industrial Light & Magic]] was done by [[Dermot Power]] with the production code "dp481". In the art, Bobissia has beige and light-blue skin. Power's later added note on the artwork calls the character "Ony bibissia". Power also used he/him pronouns for the character.<ref name="IG">{{Instagram|username=powerdermot|name=[[Dermot Power]]|url=p/CZjFujRKe-z|date=2022-02-04|quote=No memory of doing this guy- right from the end of Ep 2 when I was doing costumes for ILM’s CG characters - spotted him when searching for Wednesday’s Wookie|archivefile=File:OnyBobissia-DermotPower-Instagram.png}} {{C|Comment by Power: "definitely has that stuffy professor feel"; in response to: "👏he’s nearly a Hogwarts refugee"}}</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Bobissia's name was confirmed by<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member<ref name="SW Show Interview">{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] on [[January 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="Twitter" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character was first identified as [[Ony Bobissia]] in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] in 2002.<ref name="DB" /> Power shared concept art of Bobissia on his [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] profile on [[February 4]], 2022. Power had had no memory of drawing the character until he found the artwork while searching for an image of a [[Wookiee]] to post. Power also said that the character reminded him of a professor from [[Wikipedia:Hogwarts|Hogwarts]]<ref name="IG" /> from the [[Wikipedia:Harry Potter (film series)|''Harry Potter'' films]], on which he had also worked as a concept artist around the same time.<ref name="PowerHP">{{WebCite|url=https://dermotpower.com/harry-potter-and-the-chamber-of-secrets|work=[[Dermot Power]]'s website|text=Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets|archivedate=20260214183008}}</ref>
